messages:
Aisha (Sales): Quick handoff for HeliosRx (EU-based pharma). Contract signed last week; they want a Private deployment (on-prem connector + VPC) and data residency in eu-west-1. They use embeddings heavily (semantic search + vector DB), expect bursts up to ~500 req/s during working hours, avg payload ~800 tokens. They care about streaming latency for real-time triage and strict GDPR/DPA wording. Procurement is asking for a clear cost/run-rate estimate before enabling Dedicated. Can CS pick up onboarding + weekly enablement calls? SE needed to validate embedding vector size, index compatibility, and recommend quant/batch for cost savings. Support to own connector/ops checklist. I dropped sales notes + sample payload in 1Password: https://1password.example/sales/heliosrx and test creds in shared vault. Can we sync Fri 9am CET?

Connor (CS): I'll own onboarding & enablement. Friday 09:00 CET works. I'll create a customer runbook template and a short enablement slide that highlights expected SLOs, cost levers (batching, cache), and rollback/fallback strategies. Can Aisha confirm legal point of contact for DPA review?

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Ravi here 8219


 I'll scope embedding vector size (are they using 1536 or 2048 dims?), and run a quick index-compat test against Milvus/FAISS samples. Aisha, can you paste an anonymized sample (schema + dims)? Also will run a perf bench with streaming enabled. Example bench: ```python
import requests
r = requests.post('https://bench.redwood.internal/stream', json={'model':'embed-large','seq':512,'requests':200})
print(r.status_code)
``` 

Tanya (Support): I'll prepare the on-prem connector preflight checklist (openssh keys, outbound egress, certs, storage reqs) and an ops runbook for handover. Tagging infra-oncall for network rules.

contracts-bot: DPA ticket CREATED: DPA-9142 (assigned to Legal). Link: https://contracts.redwood/dpa/9142

Connor (CS): Owners: Aisha = sales liaison, Connor = CS onboarding lead (CS-4899), Ravi = SE (embedding & perf), Tanya = Support lead for on-prem connector, Legal via contracts-bot for DPA. I've opened CS-4899 and added an abstract checklist. I'll send calendar invite for Fri 09:00 CET.

Aisha (Sales): Shared anonymized sample payload and procurement contact (procurement@heliosrx.example). Procurement wants a line-item cost projection: monthly token estimate, storage for embeddings, expected network egress. Also flagged potential renewal risk: high if unit economics don't meet their SAP benchmarks.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Noted procurement ask. I'll produce a 3-tier cost projection (conservative/expected/optimistic) and a technical recommendation: prefer 8-bit quant for encoder, per-route cache for hot queries, and a fallback lightweight model for peak protection. Plan to post initial perf numbers and index compatibility notes by Thu EOD.

Tanya (Support): Preflight notes: required firewall outbound to 52.19.120.7/32 and 52.19.120.8/32, ports 443 and 8443. We'll need SAML certs if they want SSO for admin UI. Adding checklist to CS-4899.

Connor (CS): I'll prep an enablement deck that includes contact points, expected timelines (week 0 provisioning, week 1 SSO + perf tuning, week 2 internal trial), and a feedback capture form to surface early quality issues back to Product. Will also add a renewal-risk mitigation section (cost controls + pilot metrics).

Aisha (Sales): Thanks all 
 please cc procurement on the Friday invite. I'll join the call to intro the procurement lead and technical contacts.

infra-oncall: Noted. We'll standby for network validation during provisioning window.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): Posting first bench summary here after run: p50 streaming latency ~220ms (eu-west-1), embeddings index upsert throughput ~1500 vectors/min on test VM. Recommending per-request batch size 16 and 8-bit quant for embeddings encoder to cut cost ~28%. Full notes attached to CS-4899.

Tanya (Support): Checklist attached and ops window requested for week 0 provisioning 
.

Connor (CS): Closing loop 
 Invite sent, ticket CS-4899 updated, owners assigned. I'll run weekly enablement starting next Monday and capture feedback in the runbook. If any blockers (legal/dpa, procurement), flag here.

Aisha (Sales): Appreciate it. Procurement will be on the Fri call.

Ravi (Solutions Eng): +1

Tanya (Support): +1

contracts-bot: DPA-9142 linked to CS-4899.
